sources.primary_title: Join the Builders Tribe Founder Delegation at LEAP 2026
sources.verified_angle_summary: Builders Tribe and the Pakistan IT Industry Association (P@SHA) are leading dedicated founder delegations to LEAP 2026 in Riyadh, underscoring the event's role as a vital bridge between emerging markets and the GCC's thriving tech ecosystem. Builders Tribe's delegation aims to connect African and global founders with regional investors and potential partners, facilitating cross-border expansion in sectors like fintech and AI. Simultaneously, P@SHA is organizing a delegation to showcase Pakistan's IT capabilities, helping local companies explore export opportunities and forge long-term partnerships in the Middle East. This angle is distinct as it focuses on specific, organized efforts to integrate emerging market startups into the Saudi digital economy.
sources.verified_key_facts: Builders Tribe is leading an exclusive founder delegation to LEAP 2026 to connect entrepreneurs with the GCC startup ecosystem; The Builders Tribe initiative targets cross-border opportunities, particularly between Africa and the GCC, in sectors like fintech and AI; The Pakistan IT Industry Association (P@SHA) is also taking a delegation to LEAP 2026; P@SHA's delegation aims to showcase Pakistani IT companies and explore business, investment, and partnership opportunities in the Middle East; Both delegations emphasize networking with international tech leaders, investors, and enterprise decision-makers at the Riyadh event.
